title: Attestation lab: scratch notes and control mapping
content:
Purpose: jotting friction, mapping ideas + open questions for the attestation sprint. Not polished; notes to self and quick action items.

Quick context
- Goal: get a lean evidence deck for CC and security criteria covering Hosted API + Dedicated + Private.
- Audience: internal auditors first pass, then external auditor (TBD vendor).
- Scope: production runtime, control plane, access provisioning, key mgmt, observability/tracing, incident mgmt.

High-level gaps I think we have to validate (rough)
- Logical access: RBAC role matrix exists but not consistently exported for Dedicated customers. Need snapshot process.
- KMS: Hosted uses cloud KMS; Private can be customer-managed KMS but docs unclear on per-tenant key separation.
- Change mgmt: release notes exist but linkage to config changes (infra-as-code) -> evidence is incomplete.
- Logging/retention: token-level logs and request/response traces are available in console but retention policies + export paths need documentation.
- Vendor mgmt: some infra vendors (observability, third-party embeddings) not fully inventoried in vendor list.

Control mapping (first draft)
- CC: Logical Access (A): what product artifacts/evidence?
  - Redwood Console: role definitions (admin, devops, support, billing). Evidence = role JSON snapshot from IAM, most recent access review (sheet).
  - SSO (OKTA): SAML config screenshots + SSO group -> role mapping doc.
  - JIT access for support: auth logs showing time-limited sessions (sample).

- CC: Change Control (B): artifacts/evidence
  - PRs merged with changelog tags + deploy pipeline runs (CI logs).
  - Infra-as-code commits in terraform repo + tagging. Evidence = commit hashes + deployment timestamps.
  - Approval tickets: Jira links for prod config changes (sample subset).

- CC: Logging & Monitoring (C): artifacts/evidence
  - Audit logs (cloud) export samples (Cloud Audit / GCP logs).
  - Application-level request traces (datadog/observability) with matching request ids.
  - Retention config: S3/GCS lifecycle policy screenshot.

- CC: Key Management & Cryptography (D): artifacts/evidence
  - KMS key rotation policy, rotation logs.
  - For Private: customer KMS onboarding checklist + HSM attestation (if used).

- CC: Incident Response (E): artifacts/evidence
  - Incident runbook, tabletop notes, recent incidents (redacted).
  - Pager duty rotations, escalation matrix.

Open questions / TODOs (priority ordering)
1) Dedicated instance KMS: do we use a single master key for all Dedicated customers or per-tenant keys? Owner: Priya. Need: architecture note + example evidence file.
2) Access review cadence: current sheet shows last review but not formalized for SRE/support accounts. Owner: Maya. Need: export of last 6 months + proposed monthly cadence doc.
3) Log retention for Hosted API: auditors ask for 12 months. Current default retention = 90 days. Action: propose retention policy with cost estimate (Elliot).
4) Evidence packaging: decide on a canonical export format for sample evidence (zip with index.md). Owner: me (Jordan) — prototype.
5) Vendor inventory: gap list to get to 100% (who owns vendor risk?). Make a quick one-pager + owner tag.

Quick checklist for next 2 weeks
- [ ] Snapshot IAM roles + export to shared folder (link in CONFLUENCE).
- [ ] Collect 5 sample deploy PRs + CI artifacts for change mgmt evidence.
- [ ] Draft KMS onboarding checklist for Private customers (include notes about HSM if applicable).
- [ ] Draft retention policy proposal and simple cost calc for 12mo vs 90d.
- [ ] Run quick tabletop for incident response (30m) and record notes.

Notes-to-self: evidence sampling strategy
- auditors do not need full datasets; pick samples that represent control operation (3–5 samples per control).
- redactions: always remove customer data from logs, replace with placeholders and include mapping table.
- index file must map sample -> ticket/PR/log/time so auditor can follow chain.

Slack/Jira links I referenced
- slack: #trust-ops (thread pinned: "attestation-sprint-2026")
- jira: SEC-412 (vendor inventory), SEC-420 (KMS questions), SEC-399 (log retention policy)
- confluence: infra/security/soc2-prep (living doc)

Possible quick wins (low effort, high signal)
- export last 90 days of audit logs for a single customer and attach index -> shows pipeline for logs.
- snapshot of console RBAC and an explanation note.
- simple single-page evidence index (index.md) with 10 bullets + links.

Rough owners and timeline (2-week sprint)
- Jordan: evidence index prototype + sample packaging (3 days)
- Priya: KMS design note + sample keys mapping (4 days)
- Maya: access review exports + cadence proposal (3 days)
- Elliot: retention cost calc + recommendation (2 days)

Misc scribbles (might be important later)
- auditor might ask for encryption in-transit cert expiry proof — need cert rotation docs.
- Dedicated autoscaling events: do we show capacity testing as part of availability control? capture last canary stress test.
- Private on-prem install: need checklist showing secure defaults for firewall, NTP, admin accounts.

End of scratch. Save as draft; will tidy into confluence page once we have sample zips.
